name: Scenic Half Marathon Pranburi
short_description: A half-marathon and multi-distance running event held at Paknam Pran Beach Park in Pranburi, Thailand on February 15, 2026.
ai_summary: The Scenic Half Marathon Pranburi is scheduled for February 15, 2026, at Paknam Pran Beach Park in Pranburi, Prachuap Khiri Khan, Thailand. Organized by the Scenic Marathon Series, the event offers four distance options: 21.1km, 10km, 5km, and 3km, catering to a range of runners from casual participants to half-marathon competitors. Registration details have not yet been announced.
